title: Disaster Finance & Parametric Triggers
prompt:
Create the complete enterprise Disaster Finance and Parametric Funding Management dashboard for ClimateGuard AI.
Maintain strict consistency with the dark navy design system (Background #07111F, Nav/Sidebar #0B1728, Card surfaces #101F33, Elevated surfaces #162840, Primary Cyan #22D3EE, Primary Blue #3B82F6, Risk colors: Safe #22C55E, Moderate #EAB308, High #F97316, Critical #EF4444).

Key Sections & Requirements:
1. Top Banner & Page Header:
   - "SIMULATION ONLY • Parametric Testnet Environment (Sepolia Block #9,481,204)" highlighted disclaimer badge in cyan/blue translucent pill.
   - Title: "Disaster Finance & Parametric Triggers"
   - Subtitle: "Simulate parametric trigger payouts, monitor reserve capital pools, evaluate trigger conditions, and audit automated relief disbursements."
   - Action buttons: "Liquidity Controls", "Audit Trail Export (CSV/PDF)", and prominent "+ Create Funding Rule" primary button.

2. Financial Overview KPI Cards (Top Row - 4 Cards):
   - Card 1: "Total Simulated Liquidity Pool" -> $42,500,000 USD (+12.4% pool capacity vs Q2, Solvency Factor 3.2x, Cap $60M)
   - Card 2: "Pending Funding Verifications" -> $6,200,000 USD (3 Active Multi-Sig Verifications, Oracle Quorum 4/5 Nodes, ETA ~18 mins)
   - Card 3: "Active Trigger Rules" -> 8 Rules (3 Thresholds Exceeded in last 48h, 24 Parametric Contracts, Auto-execution: ON)
   - Card 4: "Approved Simulated Payouts" -> $28,150,000 USD (Avg Payout Velocity: 4.2 Hours vs 45-day traditional claims, 14 Disaster Incidents, Settlement Rate 100%)

3. Analytical Graphs & Distribution (Middle Section - 2 Columns):
   - Left Column (60%): "Cumulative Simulated Liquidity & Capital Distribution"
     - Timeframe filter pills: "30 Days (Active)", "90 Days", "YTD", "All Time"
     - Sub-metrics: Floods ($22.0M • 51.8%), Drought Relief ($14.0M • 32.9%), Heatwave Emergency ($6.5M • 15.3%)
     - High-fidelity SVG chart showing monthly liquidity reserve line + parametric payout step-area curve with clear axis labels and tooltips.
   - Right Column (40%): "Payout Velocity & Oracle Consensus Engine"
     - Comparative metric card: ClimateGuard AI Parametric Payout (4.2 Hours automated telemetry verification) vs Traditional Disaster Adjusting (45 Days manual damage inspection).
     - Live Consensus Status: 99.94% Oracle Consensus (Zero Basis Risk), validated through multi-constellation satellite feeds (Sentinel-2, GPM IMERG, ERA5 Reanalysis).
     - Multisig Escrow Vault health indicator with quorum status.

4. Parametric Rule Configuration & Active Trigger Policies (3-4 Card Grid):
   - Header with active count and filter: "Active Parametric Trigger Rules" (with "+ New Rule" CTA).
   - Rule Card 1: Mekong Flash Flood Trigger v2.1 (Status: ACTIVE / TRIGGERED - Red #EF4444 pill). Condition: Discharge > 12,000 m³/s for 6h. Current: 12,480 m³/s (Exceeded). Max Payout: $5,000,000. Quick action: "Audit Trigger Condition".
   - Rule Card 2: Sahel Drought Soil Depletion v4.0 (Status: MONITORING - Cyan #22D3EE pill). Condition: Root Soil Moisture < 12% for 21d. Current: 13.8% (Day 14). Max Payout: $8,000,000. Quick action: "Configure Parameters".
   - Rule Card 3: Urban Heatwave Health Relief v1.9 (Status: ACTIVE / STANDBY - Green #22C55E pill). Condition: Wet-Bulb > 32°C for 72h. Current: 29.4°C (Sub-threshold). Max Payout: $2,500,000. Quick action: "Configure Parameters".

5. Recent Transactions & Simulated Disbursements Audit Log (Full Width Table):
   - Filter controls: Search by Request ID/Region, Hazard selector dropdown, Status filter ("All", "Pending Risk Review", "Executed", "Simulated Approved"), "Export Audit Proofs" button.
   - Table columns:
     - Request ID (e.g. CG-FIN-9821, CG-FIN-9818, CG-FIN-9790, CG-FIN-9755, CG-FIN-9732)
     - Monitored Region / Catchment (e.g., Lower Mekong Delta Sector 4, Northern Kenya Pastoral Belt, Brahmaputra River Basin, Jacobabad Thermal Corridor, Chari-Logone Catchment)
     - Hazard Indicator (Flood, Drought, Heatwave with distinct icon and badge)
     - Triggering Rule & Threshold Telemetry (e.g., Discharge > 12,000 m³/s, NDVI Deficit -0.32σ, WBGT > 32°C)
     - Calculated Payout Amount ($5,000,000 USD, $8,000,000 USD, $12,000,000 USD, etc.)
     - Multi-Sig Audit Status (Pill badges: "Pending Risk Review" in Yellow/Red, "Executed (3.8h)" in Green, "Simulated Approved" in Blue)
     - Timestamp (UTC)
     - Action: "View Simulation Proof" modal trigger / "Inspect Oracle Data".
   - Table footer: Cryptographic Merkle Root hash (0x8f4c...39a1 notarized on Sepolia Testnet) with pagination controls.

6. Modal / Slide-out Component: "Create New Parametric Funding Rule"
   - Display an elegant, functional open modal overlay on top or toggleable UI preview illustrating the Rule Configuration Form:
     - Form Header: "Create Parametric Funding Rule" with "Simulation Environment" badge and close button.
     - Field 1: Rule Name (e.g., "Indus Basin Monsoon Surge Protocol")
     - Field 2: Hazard Type Selector (Radio pills with icons: Flash Flood, Extreme Heat, Agricultural Drought)
     - Field 3: Geographic Boundary / Target Catchment (Dropdown selector: "Indus Basin NW - Zone 43N", "Lower Mekong", etc.)
     - Field 4: Primary Oracle Trigger Metric (Dropdown: River Discharge m³/s, Wet-Bulb Globe Temp °C, Root Zone Soil Moisture %)
     - Field 5: Threshold Trigger Operator & Value (Operator: ">=" or "<=", Value: "12,000", Duration: "6 Hours continuous")
     - Field 6: Maximum Simulated Payout Cap ($ Amount: "$5,000,000 USD")
     - Field 7: Automated Multi-Sig Execution Toggle (Switch: ON)
     - Modal Footer Actions: "Cancel" secondary button, "Deploy Parametric Rule" cyan primary button.

Ensure impeccable layout balance, crystal-clear typography hierarchy using Manrope, precision borders, SVG telemetry curves, realistic financial numbers, and zero visual clutter.
